message.content: {"verdict":"PAY","cited_clauses":[1,2,5,6],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"The invoice bills only for days worked in the billing month at a rate that does not exceed the agreement.","evidence_quote":"Billing period: 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31; Days billed: 14, within the 15-day monthly cap.; Day rate billed does not exceed the agreed 350 USDC."},{"clause":2,"finding":"The billed days do not exceed the monthly cap in the agreement.","evidence_quote":"Agreed day rate: 350 USDC; cap 15 days per month; Days billed: 14, within the 15-day monthly cap."},{"clause":5,"finding":"This invoice is not a duplicate of work already paid.","evidence_quote":"No other invoice on file covers this invoice number or period."},{"clause":6,"finding":"The invoice was received within 60 days of the end of the billing period.","evidence_quote":"Received 2026-09-05, 36 days after the billing period ended (2026-07-31)."}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":false}
